theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ν : ℝ → Measure (Euclid P)) (w : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞) (p : Euclid P → Prop), (∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x, φ x ∂(ν t)) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x, φ x ∂(ν t) = ∫⁻ x, w x * φ x ∂μ) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p x) → ∀ᵐ t, ∀ᵐ x ∂(ν t), p x
